release.title: RDD2022 - The multi-national Road Damage Dataset released through CRDDC 2022
release.retrieval_method: Figshare ZIP central-directory inspection and selective India/train member reads using HTTP byte ranges; no full-archive save
release.license_handling: The repository metadata and challenge page state different CC licenses. Preserve source attribution and this conflict; confirm the relevant file/image terms before redistribution. This portfolio does not republish the source images.
release.figshare_file_md5_provenance: Figshare API computed_md5 metadata; not locally recomputed
release.image_count_note: The CRDDC page rounds India train images to about 9,000; the RDD2022 Figshare India.zip member actually contains 7,706 India/train JPEG+XML pairs. This analysis uses the archive enumeration count.

geography_and_period.collection_description: Delhi and Gurugram metropolitan areas, with other collection areas mainly in Haryana
geography_and_period.collection_vintage: RDD2022 release; collection period is not a crash-event period

use_limitations: Images are road-surface condition examples and are not linked to any crash record, date, or coordinate.
A detected defect cannot be described as a cause or predictor of an observed crash.
The challenge test split has no public annotations and is not used for this evaluation.
Collection areas and conditions do not represent every Indian road or season.

selective_archive_profile.selection: Only India/train .jpg and .xml files; no test or other-country members.
